title: Crispy Cheesy Chipotle Beef Tacos
author: JalalSamFit
ingredients: Splash of Water or Beef Broth
instructions: Add light butter to pan on medium heat. Cook chopped onion and garlic 5 mins till soft. Add ground beef, cook until brown, add seasoning with tomato & chipotle paste.
Mix till golden, add splash of water or beef broth. Mix till juicy and delicious.

Large sheet pan, add cooking spray and sprinkle paprika. Dip tacos in beef juices then oil and lay them out evenly. Fill generously with mozzarella and chipotle beef. Fold tightly, oven bake 16 mins, flipping halfway, until golden & crispy.
In 2 separate bowls, make honey chipotle sauce and pineapple pico. Serve with cheesy tacos & ENJOY!
